description: Hide exactly three capital letters in this area, each a different way, so they are readable once noticed but blend into the scene: 1) a capital letter O formed by the twigs and leaves of the round door wreath; 2) a capital letter D carved faintly into the wood of the upper door panel, same colour as the door, only a subtle engraving; 3) a capital letter R shaped by thin ivy stems on the wall left of the door. Keep everything else in the image exactly as it is. No other letters, numbers or text.
